Former MLA Accused of Assaulting Wife

Former Samajwadi Party leader Guddu Pandit is accused of assaulting his wife, Archana, who is also the state vice-president of the Congress Mahila Sabha. Reports state Pandit allegedly dragged and beat his wife. The incident was reported by Hindi-language outlets.
